answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing maps identity trust on a topological network graph dubbed an atlas. Independent cut verifications identify disjoint path bottlenecks; any colluding Sybil cluster attempting a velvet split across these cuts faces cross-auditor challenges. Detected false consensus triggers immediate stake slashing, drowning illicit profits under an ocean of collateral loss and imposing superlinear attacker cost.
